P: Serve the snacks when the Coneheads consume mass quantities.
S: Thin sliced potatoes fried crisp and salted, piled by the bowlful
Potatoes sliced thin on a mandoline, fried at 170C in batches, salted. Make far more than you think you need.

Mini waffle cones filled with creamy poached chicken salad with celery, chives and toasted almonds, topped with a cherry tomato point. Poach 500g chicken breast in simmering salted water for 15 minutes, cool and shred finely. Mix with 120g mayo, 2 tbsp sour cream, 2 finely diced celery sticks, 2 tbsp chives, 30g chopped toasted almonds, lemon juice, salt and pepper. Chill 20 minutes. Just before serving, spoon into 12 mini waffle cones and top each with a cherry tomato.
Thick onion rings soaked in buttermilk, fried in a lager batter
Thick onion rings soaked in buttermilk, dipped in beer batter, fried at 185C until puffed.
M: Smashed beef patties with American cheese, pickles and onion, two per bun
Two smashed patties, American cheese, pickles and onion on toasted buns, stacked on a platter.
the backyard barbecue in New Jersey

Thick beef sausages and lemon garlic chicken thighs grilled over coals, with buttered corn on the cob and a creamy mustard potato salad. Marinate 800g chicken thighs in 2 tbsp oil, 2 crushed garlic cloves, lemon zest and salt for 1 hour. Boil 1kg baby potatoes until tender, halve and dress warm with 100g mayo, 1 tbsp Dijon, chopped spring onion and dill. Grill 8 thick beef sausages and the chicken over medium coals for 15 to 20 minutes, turning. Grill 4 corn cobs for 10 minutes and brush with butter.
W: Vanilla ice cream piled high in waffle cones with a chocolate shell
Soft-serve style vanilla ice cream piped high into waffle cones, dipped in chocolate magic shell (dark chocolate melted with coconut oil).
K: A jug of lager and lemonade with lemon and lime wedges

A big jug of cold lager and fizzy lemonade with fresh lemon and lime squeezed in, poured over ice, made in mass quantities. Chill 4 bottles lager (375ml) and 1.25 litres lemonade until very cold. Fill a large jug with ice and add 2 lemons and 1 lime cut into wedges, squeezing them as they go in. Pour in the lager and lemonade together, slowly so it doesn't foam over. Stir once and pour into 4 big glasses, topping up as needed.

s.note: Thin sliced potatoes fried crisp and salted, piled by the bowlful
s.how: Slice 6 potatoes thin on a mandoline, rinse and dry well. Fry at 170C in batches until golden and crisp. Salt well while hot. Make far more than seems sensible and pile them into a big bowl.

s.note: Thick onion rings soaked in buttermilk, fried in a lager batter
s.how: Cut 3 onions into thick rings and soak in 300ml buttermilk for 30 minutes. Whisk 150g flour with 250ml cold lager. Dip the rings in the batter and fry at 185C until puffed and golden. Salt and serve hot.

m.note: Smashed beef patties with American cheese, pickles and onion, two per bun
m.how: Smash 12 thin patties from 1.2kg beef mince on a hot griddle, salt and flip after 90 seconds, adding American cheese. Stack two per toasted bun with pickles and onion, 6 burgers in total, and pile them on a platter.

w.note: Vanilla ice cream piled high in waffle cones with a chocolate shell
w.how: Melt 150g dark chocolate with 2 tbsp coconut oil and cool slightly. Pipe or scoop 1L softened vanilla ice cream high into 4 waffle cones. Freeze 20 minutes, then dip the tops in the chocolate so it sets into a shell.

d.note: A jug of lager and lemonade with lemon and lime wedges
d.how: Chill 4 bottles lager (375ml) and 1.25 litres lemonade until very cold. Fill a large jug with ice and add 2 lemons and 1 lime cut into wedges, squeezing them as they go in. Pour in the lager and lemonade together, slowly so it doesn't foam over. Stir once and pour into 4 big glasses, topping up as needed.
